title: Equity Brief — 04 Sep 2026
intro: Risk-on sentiment prevails with VIX at 14.32 as global equities rally across all regions, led by strong tech performance and rotation into growth. Asian session shows robust momentum with Hang Seng +1.99% and Nikkei +1.29%, setting positive tone for European open.

sections.heading: 📈 EQUITY SUMMARY
sections.content: Risk-on sentiment prevails with VIX at 14.32 as global equities rally across all regions, led by strong tech performance and rotation into growth. Asian session shows robust momentum with Hang Seng +1.99% and Nikkei +1.29%, setting positive tone for European open.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
Hang Seng 25,715 +1.99% — China exposure driving outperformance on stimulus speculation
Nikkei 225 65,040 +1.29% — Tech exporters benefiting from weak yen and semiconductor demand
Nasdaq 26,584 +1.40% — Mega-cap tech leadership with AI names accelerating
Dow Jones 53,686 +1.18% — Broad industrials participation confirming risk appetite
FTSE MIB 52,245 +0.87% — Southern Europe catching bid on energy and financials
FTSE 100 10,832 +0.70% — Defensive positioning limiting upside despite sterling stability
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 773.17 testing weekly resistance at 775, bullish above 768 support, driven by dovish Fed positioning ahead of September payrolls.
Nasdaq 26,584 showing tech leadership with 1.40% gain, momentum favors 26,800 test if semiconductor strength persists through Taiwan export data.
Dow 53,686 lagging but confirming breadth, needs hold above 53,400 to validate industrial rotation into Q4 earnings season.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 26,003 +0.63% recovering from weekly losses but capped by manufacturing weakness, watching 26,200 resistance.
FTSE 100 10,832 +0.70% supported by energy sector strength and defensive flows into sterling assets.
CAC 40 8,286 +0.07% lagging on luxury goods profit-taking, fragile above 8,250 support.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Tesla 376.37 +5.42% leading on production ramp confirmation from Giga Berlin and autonomous driving regulatory tailwinds in EU markets.
Meta 610.68 +3.01% extending gains on advertising revenue upgrades and AI monetization progress signaled in developer conference.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Nvidia 228.45 — AI infrastructure spending cycle accelerating — Entry 227-229 — SL 222 — TP 238
LONG: Nikkei futures 65,040 — Tech export momentum plus yen weakness — Entry 64,900-65,100 — SL 64,400 — TP 66,200
SHORT/AVOID: Russell 2000 2,968 — Underperforming with negative weekly, small-cap credit concerns rising into rate uncertainty

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content: September seasonality turning negative into FOMC blackout period with positioning stretched at low VIX
